definitions.warm: One priming real answer excluded from warm percentiles, then 10 requests in the same process and loaded model session. Native contexts are recreated per request; no retained KV cache claim.
definitions.cold: Five distinct freshly force-stopped/restarted app processes, each loads saved pack/model and answers once; filesystem and OS caches are not flushed.
definitions.percentile: Nearest rank sorted value at ceil(p*N)-1; no interpolation; groups separated.
definitions.total: From retrieval start through AnswerEngine return; load reported separately. Cold ready-to-result also includes pack/model loading after instrumentation onStart, not Android launch overhead.
definitions.first_token: First callback latency from AnswerEngine entry; request first token adds measured retrieval time. Unverified draft token, not first useful content.
definitions.memory: Android Debug PSS plus /proc/self/status RSS/swap and Java used heap snapshots; sampled maxima, not allocator peaks; steady index deltas are process deltas after requested GC, not exclusive object size.
definitions.scale: Increasing duplication-only stress packs, baseline old 186-passage index and real resident model held during isolated install. Source copies and stage coexist; no added factual coverage.
definitions.boundary: Largest whole-source replication before any current import limit, plus next rejected replication. Other independent caps reported without pretending every cap is independently reachable.
